meta.name: codex-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Codex Light edition (lazycodex / packages/omo-codex) itself, in strict isolation so ONLY our plugin is exercised, never the user's real ~/.codex. The first-party method drives the real `codex app-server` against an isolated CODEX_HOME plus a LOCAL mock model (no real API call), and proves a plugin hook fired by asserting hook/started + hook/completed notifications. Also: isolated install verification, per-component hook probes, a tmux TUI smoke, and runtime log observation (RUST_LOG / logs SQLite / /debug-config). Ships tested helper scripts each with a --self-test. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-codex or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Codex plugin, its hooks/components, the installer/config.toml, the app-server flow, or the Codex TUI. Triggers: codex qa, qa codex, codex-qa, test codex plugin, verify codex hook, codex app-server, lazycodex qa, isolated CODEX_HOME, prove codex hook fired, codex tui test.

howto.what: 装上后,遇到 QA 需求时,Claude 会用隔离环境对 Codex 插件执行测试,不碰你真实的 ~/.codex,也不用真实模型 API,验证钩子、安装、界面等,并把证据写入 .omo/evidence 目录。
howto.when: 当你说“codex qa”“qa codex”“test codex plugin”等,或要求验证/调试 Codex 插件、钩子、安装、TUI 等时触发。

say.text: 请对 codex 插件跑一遍完整 QA。
say.note: 会先检查依赖,再在隔离环境执行测试。

say.text: 验证 codex 钩子是否触发。
say.note: 用 app-server 通知流证明钩子已触发。

say.text: 测试 codex 插件安装是否正确。
say.note: 在隔离的 CODEX_HOME 里安装并校验。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude runs QA on the omo Codex plugin in strict isolation—isolated CODEX_HOME plus a local mock model—so your real ~/.codex is untouched and no real API call is made. It verifies hooks, install, and TUI smoke, and writes evidence files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'codex qa', 'qa codex', 'test codex plugin', etc., or ask to verify/debug the Codex plugin, its hooks, components, installer, or TUI.

say_en.text: Run a full QA on the codex plugin.
say_en.note: Checks deps first, then runs isolated tests.

say_en.text: Verify whether the codex hook fires.
say_en.note: Uses app-server notification stream as proof.
Installs into an isolated CODEX_HOME and verifies.
